HX01:
$/name = ""
$/zone = ""
$/tag = ""
name = TextField(label="离线名称",value=$/name)
zone = TextField(label="离线区域",value=$/zone)
tag = TextField(label="离线标签",value=$/tag)
submit = Button(child=Text(text="提交信息"),action=Event("submit",{offlineName:$/name,offlineZone:$/zone,offlineTag:$/tag}))
validation = FormValidation(buttons=["submit"],rules=[{fieldId:"name",message:"Required",required:true},{fieldId:"zone",message:"Required",required:true},{fieldId:"tag",message:"Required",required:true}])
root = Column(children=[name,zone,tag,validation,submit])
